label: Listening 1 — Five short dialogues
lines: Listening one. Listen to five short dialogues.
Good morning, Tom. You're early today!
Hi! I'm Katie. I'm new here.
Hi, Katie! Nice to meet you. I'm Ben.
Nice to meet you too, Ben.
Hello, Mr Hill. How are you?
I'm fine, thank you. And you?
Good evening! Welcome to the party.

label: Listening 2 — Where are they from?
lines: Listening two. Five students at a summer school. Where are they from?
Hello! I'm Ken. I'm from Japan.
Hi, my name's Sophie. I'm French.
Hi! I'm Carlos. I'm from Spain.
Hi there! I'm Jack. I'm from the USA.

label: Listening 3 — At a summer camp
lines: Listening three. At a summer camp. Listen and complete.
Hello! Welcome to the camp. What's your name?
Hello! My name is Anna Baker, and I am new here.
Thank you. Are you from Spain, Anna?
No, I'm not. I'm from Poland.
This is my friend Rosa. She's Mexican.
Nice to meet you, Rosa! OK, you're in group B.
We're in group B. Thank you!
